name: Wartrain Mount
levelText: antipaladin 1, bard 2, druid 2, hunter 1, inquisitor 1, mesmerist 2, paladin 1, ranger 1, skald 2
componentsText: V, S, M (a swatch of black cloth)
target: Target: one indifferent or friendly animal
description: You instill the target animal with the combat training general purpose (see the Handle Animal skill). This supersedes the animal’s previous trained purpose and any tricks it knows. When the spell ends, it reverts to its previous trained purpose and known tricks.
